items.title: What are the main events for today?
items.summary: EUROPEAN SESSION In the European session, we have the Eurozone Q2 GDP, the German CPI and the BoE rate decision. The Eurozone Q2 GDP is expected at 0.2% vs -0.2% prior. The data shouldn't change much for the ECB as it's more focused on inflation.  Speaking of inflation, we get both the German state inflation readings and the national CPI.
items.summaryZh: 欧洲会议在欧洲会议上，我们有欧元区第二季度GDP、德国CPI和英国央行利率决策。欧元区第二季度GDP预计为0.2% ，而之前为-0.2%。欧洲央行的数据应该不会有太大变化，因为它更关注通货膨胀。说到通货膨胀，我们得到了德国国家通货膨胀读数和国家消费物价指数。
